Check size of $500K to $3M appears on golden.ventures and BetaKit, currency not stated on the page; not recorded as check range. Homepage states fund size of $100M (2024); BetaKit puts Fund V at about US$103M (C$139M), final close in December 2023, article 22 Feb 2024.
Golden.ventures homepage does not state HQ; Toronto is from BetaKit text. Application is by email to a published address (not recorded); FAQ not fetched.
Lead mentions Golden Venture Partners funds from 2011; the 2011 start is on the homepage ('investing since June 2011') but earlier funds not recorded (latest only).
